description: Farm/rural props: hay bales, troughs, grain sacks, farm tools, tractors/implements, pens.
Boundary/traffic control: fences, gates, bollards, cones, road blockers, concrete barriers, hydrants.
Modular architecture kit pieces: walls, roofs, columns, arches, doors, windows, stairs.
Whole buildings, facades, shopfronts, houses, towers, warehouses, hangars — backdrop structures.
Camping/recreation gear: tents, campfires, coolers, folding chairs, backpacks.
Mobile/standalone vendor units: food carts, market stalls, hand trucks, vending fridges.
Decorative/civic features: fountains, statues, monuments, public art, ornamental landmarks, vases.
Indoor furniture: sofas, cabinets, shelves, desks, beds (off-theme for outdoor scenes).
Ground/surface pieces: road tiles, sidewalks, curbs, plaza tiles, sewer caps/manholes.
Off-theme indoor/random clutter: appliances, medical/lab, school/office, bathroom/sports, misc props.
Logistics/cargo + heavy equipment: containers, pallets, crates, drums, cranes, machinery.
Light fixtures: street lamps, lampposts, floodlights, lanterns, torches, hanging/signal lights.
Small ground clutter: cans, bottles, cups, paper, trash, broken glass, rubble.
Market/shop goods: produce, sacks, baskets, pottery, rugs, crates of wares, hanging produce.
Medieval/fantasy/gothic props: barrels, anvils, wells, timber, tombstones, coffins, banners, weapon racks.
Natural terrain: rocks, boulders, cliffs, logs, stumps, dirt/gravel mounds, ground foliage.
Industrial infrastructure: pipes, valves, vents, ducts, storage tanks, transformers, switchboards.
Religious/ritual objects: idols, altars, shrines, braziers, incense burners, prayer lanterns.
Sci-fi props: futuristic crates, control panels, terminals, consoles, energy cells, sci-fi machinery.
Seating and small tables: benches, chairs, stools, cafe/park tables.
Signs and displays: shop signs, billboards, ad panels, warning signs, posters, banners.
Tools and equipment: ladders, wheelbarrows, hand/power tools, toolboxes, work gear.
Plants: trees, bushes, hedges, flowers, potted plants, shrubs, foliage.
Drivable/parked vehicles: cars, vans, trucks, scooters, carts, boats, wagons.
Refuse containers: trash/recycling bins, dumpsters, garbage bags, oil barrels.
Winter/snow props: snow piles, firewood stacks, sleds, snow-covered objects, ice.
